'''Hinjawadi''' (also incorrectly spelt '''Hinjewadi''' and '''Henjewadi''') is a suburb in [[Pune]], India. It houses the Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park, a large [[technology park|tech]] and [[business park]] spread over 2,800 acres, which was built by the [[Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kulkarni |first1=Prachee |title=Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park in Hinjawadi facing infrastructural problems |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/west/rajiv-gandhi-infotech-park-in-hinjewadi-facing-infrastructural-problems/articleshow/12467920.cms |access-date=18 May 2021 |work=The Economic Times |date=30 March 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Kulkarni |first1=Prachee |title=Infrastructure woes spark exodus of IT cos from Hinjawadi |url=https://punemirror.indiatimes.com/pune/cover-story/infrastructure-woes-spark-exodus-of-it-cos-from-hinjawadi/articleshow/65648790.cms |access-date=18 May 2021 |work=Pune Mirror |date=3 September 2018 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.financialexpress.com/money/hinjawadi-an-investors-paradise-in-pune/2568206/ | title=Hinjawadi: An investor's paradise in Pune }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/pune/hinjawadi-no-1-liveable-city-in-india/articleshow/78403304.cms | title=Hinjawadi: No. 1 liveable city in India | Pune News - Times of India | website=[[The Times of India]] }}</ref> The business park has offices of over 800 companies.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/pune-where-panic-reins-an-it-campus/article18591285.ece|title=Pune, where panic reigns an IT campus|last=Banerjee|first=Shoumojit|date=27 May 2017|work=The Hindu|access-date=13 June 2018|language=en-IN|issn=0971-751X|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170527171136/http://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/pune-where-panic-reins-an-it-campus/article18591285.ece|archive-date=27 May 2017|url-status=live}}</ref>

== Transport ==

===Road transport===
[[File:PMPML-Airport-Bus-Hinjewadi-University.jpg|thumb|left|PMPML airport bus]]
Given to rapid development, Hinjawadi is prone to severe traffic congestion during the peak hours i.e. 8.00 AM to 12:00 PM and 5.30 PM to 8.00 PM. Accordingly, the HMVs (Heavy Motor Vehicles) are barred from entering Hinjawadi during these hours. The area sees a commute of roughly over 240,000 employees on a daily basis to and from the IT park.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/pune-news/commuters-heave-a-sigh-of-relief-after-one-way-traffic-eases-congestion-in-hinjewadi/story-7rGoia9jvtAzTfR6Ssvy7M.html|title=Commuters heave a sigh of relief after one-way traffic eases congestion in Hinjewadi|date=15 September 2018}}</ref>

===Bus===
{{Main|Pune Mahanagar Parivahan Mahamandal Limited}}
PMPML also operates night buses after midnight on 7 routes.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.pmpml.org/en/services/night-buses/|title=Night Buses {{!}} Pune Mahanagar Parivahan Mahamandal Ltd|website=www.pmpml.org|language=en|access-date=16 May 2018|archive-date=2 December 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221202014547/https://pmpml.org/en/services/night-buses/|url-status=dead}}</ref> PMPML also runs special services for tourists under the name 'Pune Darshan' as well as airport services from Rajiv Gandhi IT Park, Hinjawadi to [[Pune Airport]]. PMPML goes to various areas of [[Pune]] such as [[Katraj]], [[Baner]], [[Kothrud]], [[Pune Municipal Corporation|Manapa Bhavan]], [[Pune Junction railway station|Pune Station]], [[Hadapsar]], [[Thergaon]], [[Marunji]], [[Chandkhed]], [[Khamboli]],[[Pirangut|Ghotawade Phata]], [[Bhosari]], [[Alandi]], [[Nigdi]], [[Chinchwad]], [[Kharadi]], [[Yerwada]], [[Akurdi]], [[Chikhali, Pune|Chikhali]], [[Pimple Gurav]] and Kiwale.

===Metro===
{{main|Pink Line (Pune Metro)}}
[[Pink Line (Pune Metro)|Pink Line]] of the [[Pune Metro]] is the third line of the city's under-construction mass transit network. It will run from [[Shivajinagar, Pune|Civil Court, Pune]] to [[Megapolis Pune]] in Hinjawadi. The {{Cvt|23.3|km}} line will be completely elevated and will have 23 stations and will align with the Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Limited ([[Maha Metro]]) lines at the Civil Court [[interchange station]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite news|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/pune-news/central-government-approves-shivajinagar-hinjawadi-metro-corridor-on-ppp-basis/story-RzmLop1HzoMMXGgy64l0mO.html|title=Central government approves Shivajinagar-Hinjawadi Metro corridor on PPP basis|date=7 March 2018|work=hindustantimes.com/|access-date=8 March 2018|language=en}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/pune/tech-companies-keen-to-stamp-their-names-on-metro-stations/articleshow/60519665.cms|title=Tech companies keen to stamp their names on Metro stations - Times of India|work=The Times of India|access-date=10 March 2018}}</ref> Depot will be located at Maan village. It will be spread across {{Convert|20|ha}}.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://themetrorailguy.com/pune-metro-line-3-project-information-route-map-fares-tenders-updates/|title=Pune Metro Line-3 – Information, Route Map, Fares, Tenders & Updates}}</ref> The project is set to be completed in March 2025.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/pune-news/pune-metro-line-3-to-be-operational-by-march-2025-101661794597380.html|title=Pune Metro Line 3 to be operational by March 2026|date=29 August 2022|work=Hindustan Times|access-date=8 September 2023|language=en-IN}}</ref>
